command: python3 greet.py > /tmp/greet_out.txt 2> /tmp/greet_err.txt; status=$?; echo "exit_status=$status"; echo "stdout_bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/greet_out.txt)"; printf 'Hello, Agent!\n' | cmp -s - /tmp/greet_out.txt && echo "stdout_match=exact" || echo "stdout_match=MISMATCH"; [ -s /tmp/greet_err.txt ] && echo "stderr=non-empty" || echo "stderr=empty"; cat /tmp/greet_out.txt
